flows.name: B-06 真后端(Fake Agent)-生成-菜单-提问入口可用-刷新恢复-原操作可继续

steps.text: 生成 A 机房昨日能耗日报，包含总耗电、设备排名和趋势分析

steps.eval: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.question-select')).filter(s => !s.disabled).map(s => Array.from(s.options).map(o => o.textContent.trim()).join(',')).join('|') === '请选择,同意,修改,重新开始'

steps.screenshot: b06-02-刷新后草稿与原菜单都还在

steps.eval: (() => { const s = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.question-select')).filter(x => !x.disabled).pop(); const opt = Array.from(s.options).find(o => o.textContent.trim() === '同意'); if (!opt) return false; s.value = opt.value; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()
